svg.text: Opto enclosure: Hailege 8-channel AC opto board (heating demand monitor)
Mains side (230 V AC) on the left, logic side (3.3 V) on the right; the board is the isolation barrier. Mains side wired at the junction-box rewire.
Clear-lid ABS enclosure · printed tray v2
A: IN1-IN3 (brown/black/grey) · B: IN4-IN6 · C: IN7-IN8 + spare
VCC must be 3.3 V (not 5 V): the outputs connect straight to ESP32 pins, pulled up to VCC when off. Verified: all eight inputs read 3.3 V idle.
Each input LED lights only with 230 V on that channel. Mains side: brown/black/grey cores to L1-L8, each cable's blue to its neutral Wago; earth bonded.
Isolate the heating circuit at its MCB/fused spur, lock off and prove dead before opening. Live inputs come from the heating junction box, not this box.
Labels: channel numbers on the lid edge, the IN1-IN8 list on top (IN5 = DHW tank valve drive LEFT, IN6 = RIGHT).
